about: Minimum coverage a browser-lab run must reach to pass. requiredMatches must all run, and the offline reliability run (match A entirely offline, key 'A-offline', browser/offline-plan.json) must run too (a partial run is INCOMPLETE, never PASS). compareChecksMin: UI/PDF comparison checks per match (raised with each added check — last after the BL-F1–F4 repairs added "page present" checks; never lowered to make a run pass). pdfsPerMatch / legacyPdfs: every report export a run must produce. Other counts (taps, lifecycle steps, Review operations, persistence scenarios) come from the fixtures and the pass rules in tools/run-browser-lab.mjs. Protected by the test-integrity guard.
